planets.name: TOI-3235 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-3235 with a 2.59-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-3235 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-3235. Its orbit and size follow Hobson et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname HOBSON_ET_AL_2023): disc_year 2023, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 2.59261842, pl_radj 1.017, pl_bmassj 0.665

quotes.title: TOI-3235 b
quotes.card: TOI-3235 b is a gas giant exoplanet found 237 light-years away from Earth.
quotes.introduction: It was discovered in 2023 by the transit method.
